[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested ways to use chipotle peppers in adobo sauce:  
1. Chipotle Chicken Tacos: Marinate chicken in lime juice, olive oil, garlic, chipotle peppers.  
2. Smoky BBQ Sauce: Blend chipotle peppers, ketchup, brown sugar, apple cider vinegar, spices.  
3. Chipotle Deviled Eggs: Mix chipotle peppers with mayonnaise, mustard, diced onions.  
4. Spicy Black Bean Soup: Simmer black beans with chipotle peppers, onions, garlic, vegetable broth.  
5. Chipotle Lime Roasted Vegetables: Toss vegetables with olive oil, lime juice, chipotle peppers, roast.  
6. Chipotle Aioli: Mix chipotle peppers with mayonnaise, lime juice, garlic.  
7. Smoky Braised Short Ribs: Braise short ribs with red wine, beef broth, chipotle peppers.
